items.title: Price Level Adjustments — Mews RMS
items.summary: Revenue managers can now apply % price level adjustments across all room types or specific categories, for all future dates or a custom range, directly from the Pricing section in RMS.
items.pitch: Price level adjustments bring a faster, more flexible way to manage recommendations in Mews RMS. Set a percentage, pick your scope, choose your date range, and you are done.

items.title: Central Accounting Categories — Multi-Property
items.summary: Accounting categories can now be defined once at portfolio level and assigned across all properties. Updates propagate automatically, replacing per-property setup.
items.pitch: Define once, assign everywhere. Central accounting categories in Mews Multi-Property bring consistency to your portfolio financial reporting with no extra effort.

items.title: Better Receipts + Payout Visibility
items.summary: Payment receipts now print with property logo, name, and address. The payment detail panel shows payout ID, status, and last updated date.
items.pitch: Receipts now look the part with your property branding, and payout traceability is built right into the payment detail panel. Less hunting, more confidence.

items.title: Ledger Manual Export (Deposit + Guest Ledger)
items.summary: Staff can now export the Deposit and Guest Ledger directly from the report page. Active filters carry through to the export in Excel, JSON, or CSV format.
items.pitch: The Deposit and Guest Ledgers now work the same way the City Ledger already does. Filter your data, export it in the format you need.

items.title: Checkout from Closed Bill
items.summary: Staff can now check out guests directly from a closed bill with no screen switching. Supports batch checkout of up to 10 reservations.
items.pitch: Closing a bill and checking out are naturally sequential actions, and now they happen in the same place.
items.segmentation: NL first — broader rollout coming soon

items.title: Account Menu Redesign — Navigation
items.summary: Account and profile options moved to a dedicated menu in the bottom-left corner of Mews Operations. For Multi-Property accounts, this menu is now separate from the property selector.

items.title: Improved Navigation Menu — Mews Operations
items.summary: Navigation redesigned with always-visible icons, highlighted active location indicator, and cleaner layout. Staff can move faster with fewer clicks.
items.pitch: A small change with a big daily impact — staff always know where they are in Mews and can jump between sections without hunting.

items.title: Business on the Books Report — Mews Events
items.summary: New report giving event managers instant visibility into forward bookings and revenue by quote status (Confirmed, Optional, Inquired). Includes charts, breakdown table, date comparison, and Excel export.
items.pitch: A live, structured view of what is confirmed, optional, and inquired, with revenue broken down the way they think about it.

items.title: Front of House Performance Improvements
items.summary: Long stay reservations now create in ~3s (was timing out — 10x faster for large customers). Bill capacity doubled from 6K to 12K items. Peak concurrency success rates: 0% to 100% for reservations.

items.title: Multicurrency by Mews Payments
items.summary: Guests can view and pay in their preferred currency via Payment Links or the Mews Booking Engine. Transparent conversion rates and fees. Terminal support coming later.
items.pitch: Guests pick their currency at checkout — you earn revenue on each multicurrency transaction. Online first, terminals to follow.
items.segmentation: Opt-in — EU Adyen customers only (~150 properties) — Wave 1

items.title: New Configuration Section — Navigation
items.summary: Internal prototype testing underway. Separates setup-related navigation from day-to-day operations. Property-level only first; MMP later. Not yet released.

items.title: Mews Events — Native Rebuild
items.summary: Events being rebuilt natively inside the PMS. Current Events enters maintenance mode immediately — no new features, critical fixes only, no longer being sold. New native Events targeted late Q4 2026.
items.segmentation: Do NOT communicate to customers yet

items.title: SSO Orchestrator v3 — Internal Tool
items.summary: Agentic Slack-based pipeline provisioning SSO portfolios end-to-end. ~1/3 of requests now complete with zero interaction. Signals improving provisioning reliability for customers.
